title: Giving away his music and horn; nineteen years in music; reel ends
summary: Charles says he gave away or burned his music after quitting and had nineteen years in the business.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: You see, like I said, after I gave up that instrument, it looked like I'd never go back to it no more. I just simply gave all I could away and what I didn't give away, I burned it up and things like that. Because I never once thought that I'd ever go back to music. You ought to go to school all the time. I was 19, I was 19 long years in that business.
